text.p01: To those who keep their promises like Carol A Story about Buliding Trust
text.p03: Deep in the shimmering blue sea, lived a young fish named Finn who admired his big sister, Coral.
text.p04: Carol knew all the best hiding spots in the coral reef,
text.p05: and Finn loved following her on exciting underwater adventures.
text.p06: Coral was strong and fast, while Finn was still learning how to swim through the ocean currents.
text.p07: But he always trusted his sister to guide him.
text.p08: One sunny morning, Coral promised to stay close while they explored a new part of the reef.
text.p09: “Stick with me, Finn,” she said. “We’ll have fun together.”
text.p10: But as they swam, Coral got excited and sped ahead, leaving Finn behind.
text.p11: Finn called out, “Wait for me!” but Coral was too far to hear.
text.p12: Suddenly, a big shadow passed over Finn. A curious dolphin swam by, and Finn felt scared all alone.
text.p13: The dolphin noticed Finn’s worried eyes and asked, “Hey there, little fish! What are you doing all alone in the wild sea?”
text.p14: Finn gulped. “I was swimming with my sister, but she swam too far ahead. Now I’m lost.”
text.p15: The dolphin smiled kindly. “The sea can feel big and scary alone, but don’t worry. Your sister will find you soon. Just stay calm.”
text.p16: When Coral finally noticed, she rushed back. “Finn, are you okay?” she asked,
text.p17: But Finn shook his fins. “You said you’d stay close. I don’t trust you anymore!”
text.p18: Coral felt awful. She didn’t mean to leave Finn behind,
text.p19: But she knew she had broken her promise.
text.p20: For days, Finn swam quietly, keeping his distance.
text.p21: Coral missed their fun adventures and wanted to make things right.
text.p22: One day, their mother called them both to help her.
text.p23: They shall go to gather seashells near the reef’s edge.
text.p24: Coral hesitated but swam over to Finn.
text.p25: “Want to collect shells together?” she asked with a hopeful smile.
text.p26: Finn looked at his sister. “How can I trust you won’t leave me again?” he asked angrily.
text.p27: Coral smiled gently. “Let’s try again. I’ll stay by your side this time —I promise.”
text.p28: Day by day, Finn saw that Coral kept her promise.
text.p29: Slowly, he began to trust her again.
text.p30: From that day on, Finn and Coral knew that trust wasn’t just about promises
text.p31: It was about showing up for each other, no matter what.
